name: consensys/gnark
description: A high-performance zero-knowledge proof library in Go supporting Groth16 and PLONK proving systems. Powers the Linea zk-rollup and provides a high-level API for circuit design, compilation, proving, and verification.
score_rationale: Leading production-grade ZK proof library with 1.7k stars, actively used in real blockchain infrastructure and well-maintained through 2025.
